correctness.rationale: Faithful grand-canonical stationary state and commuting swap produce both stationary parity sectors. The adjoint carré-du-champ identity with faithful state forces every imaginary-axis mode to commute with central raising and lowering, so it is identity on the middle; nonzero mirror-symmetric hopping then forces commutation with collective end ladders, whose commutant is exactly singlet/triplet projections, and the only imaginary-axis eigenvalue is zero. Bounded finite-dimensional CPTP evolution rules out peripheral Jordan blocks, hence all initial states converge with conserved parity weight. Partial trace plus explicit Wootters X-state formula yields the sharp threshold and product-state corollary; 306 independent matrix checks passed.

value.rationale: The literature source specifically identifies the loss of the vector DFS at positive temperature, leaving the natural question of whether mixed-state correlations can nevertheless persist. The complete 3-site thermal stationary attractor answers this physically motivated question for every initial state, and the exact temperature/singlet-weight frontier identifies when persistent end entanglement survives, including creation from a fully separable localized excitation. This is a natural minimal chain and a nontrivial sharp classification, not an arbitrary finite subcase.
